page.overview:
Who is Chuck?

Chuck is a large, hefty, muscular man. He has fair skin, brown eyes, and short brown hair, along with a large, spiky moustache. Chuck is shirtless and doesn't wear shirt and any shoes, typically for a Fighting-type Gym Leader.

Chuck wears loose white pants and a maroon and white belt that hangs down in front of him.

Chuck's appearance remains the same as it is in Gold and Silver.

Chuck wears jagged red pants with white-colored ends, a black belt that hangs down, and gray bandages around his wrist.
